\section{Methods}\label{sec:methods}
The symbols in Equation~\eqref{eq:weighted} have an illustrative definition:
\(x_i\) is a made-up value and \(w_i\) is a dimensionless made-up weight.
No experiment or analysis was performed.
\begin{align}
  s &= \sum_{i=1}^{n} w_i x_i,\label{eq:weighted}\\
  \Delta s &= s_{\mathrm{A}}-s_{\mathrm{B}}.\label{eq:difference}
\end{align}
All displayed precision is part of the example content. A dash in a table is
a missing entry, not zero. The illustrated unit is \(\mathrm{mmol\,L^{-1}}\).
